doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: When Adam Cato moved to California
summary: Cato moved west for good in 1948 around the time of Pasley's father's death; Pasley himself came in 1926.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Oh man. When did he move to California?

Well, he moved here for good in, let's see, in 1948. My father died in 48 and we went down to the funeral. He was already down there. And I told him I was leaving the next day. He said, well I'm going to leave. He said, I'm going back. And I left on a Thursday and I think the next day he got in his car and left.
Do you know what jobs he had in New Orleans? Did he play in bands? I don't know. Oh yeah.
I don't know where he played. He played all over New Orleans, but where I was gone.
See, I left there a long time ago.
I came here in 1926. Yeah. Oh yeah. See, so he was down there.
